S.FORM: izaw kya wawa ya wacu ya balaut.

S.FORM: izaw kya wawa ya wacu ya balaut.
S.PHON: izaw kja wawa ja waʦu ja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 有小孩、狗和青蛙.
There are a child, a dog and a frog.

FORM.notes: source note: mi-salama 為 南勢及中部阿美語；mi-hulul 北勢阿美語；mi-balakas 為Sakizaya

S.FORM: sademidemiadsa kuheni misalama.

S.FORM: sademidemiadsa kuheni misalama.
S.PHON: sadəmidəmiadsa kuħəni misa[r|ɾ]ama
S.TRANSL: 他們每天玩耍.
They play every day.

FORM.notes: source note: u chungal nu pah 酒瓶

S.FORM: pazeng han nya wawa i tiza i cungal kya balaut.
S.PHON: pazəŋ ħan nja wawa i tiza i ʦuŋa[r|ɾ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: pazeng han nya wawa i tiza i cungal kya balaut.

S.TRANSL: 那小孩把青蛙放在瓶中.
That child put the frog in the bottle.

S.FORM: tu labi satu sa mabi' kya wawa.
S.PHON: tu [r|ɾ]abi satu sa mabi[ʔ|ʡ] kja wawa
S.FORM: tu labi satu sa mabi' kya wawa.
S.PHON: tu [r|ɾ]abi satu sa mabi[ʔ|ʡ] kja wawa
S.TRANSL: 那小孩在晚上睡覺.
That child was sleeping at night.

FORM.notes: source note: 這裡是敘事者看青蛙 | source note: melaw 為阿美語 mazih 為 Sakizaya

S.FORM: melaw han kya balaut sa.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan kja ba[r|ɾ]aut sa
S.FORM: melaw han kya balaut sa.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan kja ba[r|ɾ]aut sa
S.TRANSL: 青蛙被(我們)看.
That frog was seen (by us).

S.FORM: kidem a tahkal kiza balaut nai cungal.
S.PHON: kidəm a taħka[r|ɾ] kiza ba[r|ɾ]aut nai ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: kidem a tahkal kiza balaut nai cungal.
S.PHON: kidəm a taħka[r|ɾ] kiza ba[r|ɾ]aut nai ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 在瓶子的那隻青蛙偷跑出去.
The frog that was in the bottle went out secretly.

S.FORM: mulkal sa kya wawa melaw sa tya cungal.
S.PHON: mu[r|ɾ]ka[r|ɾ] sa kja wawa mə[r|ɾ]aw sa tja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: mulkal sa kya wawa melaw sa tya cungal.
S.PHON: mu[r|ɾ]ka[r|ɾ] sa kja wawa mə[r|ɾ]aw sa tja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 那小孩醒來並看那瓶子.
That child woke up and saw that bottle.

S.FORM: inayi' kya balaut.
S.PHON: inaji[ʔ|ʡ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: inayi' kya balaut.
S.PHON: inaji[ʔ|ʡ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 青蛙不見了.
That frog disappeared.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-Ca-/ ma-sasi 為reciprocal verbal prefix | source note: tengil聽 ma-ta-tengil 互相問 | source note: ma-la-likeluh (ma-likeluh) 碰面 | source note: ma-ta-tiik 打架 ma-sa-su-tiik 互相打 | source note: 但在這有另一形式為 ma-sa-su-verb | source note: ma-sa-su-kamu 互相一起講 (開會) | source note: ma-sa-su-azih ma-sa-su-melaw 互相看 (見面)

S.FORM: kuheni a tya wacu tacuwa kya balaut sa makakilimtu.

S.FORM: kuheni a tya wacu tacuwa kya balaut sa makakilimtu.
S.PHON: kuħəni a tja waʦu taʦuwa kja ba[r|ɾ]aut sa makaki[r|ɾ]imtu
S.TRANSL: 他們去找青蛙了.
They searched for that frog.

FORM.notes: source note: belih 衍生成反對 | source note: kucu為日本漢字音，漢字寫成靴

S.FORM: i labu nu kucu belihen nya wawa.

S.PHON: i [r|ɾ]abu nu kuʦu bə[r|ɾ]iħən nja wawa
S.TRANSL: 鞋子被小孩翻過來.
The shoes were turned upside down by the child.

FORM.notes: source note: ka-kabi’-an指床上 ma-bi’ 睡覺 | source note: libung 瘟疫

S.FORM: ha kakabi'antu i kalibungantu kilim sa kuheni tya wacu tya wacu sa.

S.FORM: ha kakabi'antu i kalibungantu kilim sa kuheni tya wacu tya wacu sa.
S.PHON: ħa kakabi[ʔ|ʡ]antu i ka[r|ɾ]ibuŋantu ki[r|ɾ]im sa kuħəni tja waʦu tja waʦu sa
S.TRANSL: 他們在床上床下一直找.
They were looking for

S.FORM: pacumud han nya wacu a misanek kya cungal.
S.PHON: paʦumud ħan nja waʦu a misanək kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: pacumud han nya wacu a misanek kya cungal.
S.PHON: paʦumud ħan nja waʦu a misanək kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 狗把頭放到瓶中並聞一聞.
That dog put (his head) into the bottle and smelled it.

FORM.notes: source note: mi-caledung kaku tu zikuc我穿衣服了 (我穿衣服) | source note: ma-caledung aku kya zikuc 衣服被我穿了 | source note: ma-caledung tu aku 較mi-caledung tu 常用 | source note: si-kucu 穿鞋 | source note: si-zikuc 穿衣服

S.FORM: macaledung nya wacu kya cungal.
S.PHON: maʦa[r|ɾ]əduŋ nja waʦu kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: macaledung nya wacu kya cungal.
S.PHON: maʦa[r|ɾ]əduŋ nja waʦu kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 那狗把瓶子戴在頭上.
That dog put the bottle on its head.

FORM.notes: source note: hyahya-en 原型為hya hya -en (那樣 那樣 -受焦) 用來代替動詞，表示以那樣子重複動詞的動作，如：hyahya-en a mi-banaw 重複洗到乾淨為止。 | source note: banaw han 一直洗

S.FORM: hyahyaentu niza mibikbik kya cungal sa.
S.PHON: ħjaħjaəntu niza mibikbik kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ] sa
S.FORM: hyahyaentu niza mibikbik kya cungal sa.
S.PHON: ħjaħjaəntu niza mibikbik kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ] sa
S.TRANSL: 它一直想甩掉那瓶子.
It wanted to get rid of that bottle.

S.FORM: ca'ay kahuduc kya tangah niza i labu nu cungal.
S.PHON: ʦa[ʔ|ʡ]aj kaħuduʦ kja taŋaħ niza i [r|ɾ]abu nu ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: ca'ay kahuduc kya tangah niza i labu nu cungal.
S.PHON: ʦa[ʔ|ʡ]aj kaħuduʦ kja taŋaħ niza i [r|ɾ]abu nu ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 它拔不出頭來.
It failed to pull its head out.

S.FORM: misabalubalukudtu kya wacu.
S.PHON: misaba[r|ɾ]uba[r|ɾ]ukudtu kja waʦu
S.FORM: misabalubalukudtu kya wacu.
S.PHON: misaba[r|ɾ]uba[r|ɾ]ukudtu kja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 那狗一直踢.
That dog kept kicking.

FORM.notes: source note: mi-hetik kaku tya balaut | source note: ma-hetik aku kya balaut

S.FORM: mahetik kya wacu nai kakabi'an tahkal tayza i i sasingalan.
S.PHON: maħətik kja waʦu nai kakabi[ʔ|ʡ]an taħka[r|ɾ] tajza i i sasiŋa[r|ɾ]an
S.FORM: mahetik kya wacu nai kakabi'an tahkal tayza i i sasingalan.
S.PHON: maħətik kja waʦu nai kakabi[ʔ|ʡ]an taħka[r|ɾ] tajza i i sasiŋa[r|ɾ]an
S.TRANSL: 那狗從床上跌下去,然後走出去到窗戶.
That dog fell from bed and then went out to the window.

S.FORM: mapeci'tu kya cungal.
S.PHON: mapəʦi[ʔ|ʡ]tu kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: mapeci'tu kya cungal.
S.PHON: mapəʦi[ʔ|ʡ]tu kja ʦuŋa[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 那瓶子破了.
That bottle was broken.

S.PHON: a ja kja waʦu aku sa kja wawa
S.TRANSL: 那小孩大叫:＂我的狗啊!＂
That child exclaimed, "My dog!"

S.FORM: adada haw adada haw han niza kya wacu.

S.FORM: adada haw adada haw han niza kya wacu.
S.PHON: adada ħaw adada ħaw ħan niza kja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 他對著狗說 '會痛嗎'
He asked that dog, "Is it painful?"

S.FORM: namahtik i tiza i hekal.

S.FORM: namahtik i tiza i hekal.
S.PHON: namaħtik i tiza i ħəka[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 掉到外面了.
(They) fell outside.

S.PHON: taħka[r|ɾ]tu kuħəni miki[r|ɾ]im ba[r|ɾ]autaw ba[r|ɾ]autaw sa kja wawa atu ja waʦu[ʔ|ʡ] mikaki[r|ɾ]im i ħəka[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: tahkaltu kuheni mikilim balautaw balautaw sa kya wawa atu ya wacu' mikakilim i hekal.
S.PHON: taħka[r|ɾ]tu kuħəni miki[r|ɾ]im ba[r|ɾ]autaw ba[r|ɾ]autaw sa kja wawa atu ja waʦu[ʔ|ʡ] mikaki[r|ɾ]im i ħəka[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 他們到外面找青蛙,叫著＂青蛙啊!青蛙啊!＂
They went out to search for frog, yelled "Frog! Frog!"

S.FORM: tayzatu i tiza i lutulutukantu buyubuyu'antu mikilim kya wawa atu ya wacu.

S.FORM: tayzatu i tiza i lutulutukantu buyubuyu'antu mikilim kya wawa atu ya wacu.
S.PHON: tajzatu i tiza i [r|ɾ]utu[r|ɾ]utukantu bujubuju[ʔ|ʡ]antu miki[r|ɾ]im kja wawa atu ja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 小孩跟狗在草叢中及山中找.
The child and dog searched (for the frog) in bushes and mountains.

S.FORM: mamelaw nuheni kya kilang i tiza haw.

S.FORM: mamelaw nuheni kya kilang i tiza haw.
S.PHON: mamə[r|ɾ]aw nuħəni kja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ i tiza ħaw

They saw trees.

S.FORM: kya balaut hakay milimek i tiza sa kya wawa.
S.PHON: kja ba[r|ɾ]aut ħakaj mi[r|ɾ]imək i tiza sa kja wawa
S.TRANSL: 小孩認為青蛙可能躲在那裡.
The child thought that frog might hide over there.

S.FORM: laday hantu niza kya wacu.

S.FORM: laday hantu niza kya wacu.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]adaj ħantu niza kja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 他就帶著狗.
He brought his dog.

S.FORM: mamelaw niza kya buhang i tiza i labu i lala' balautaw balautaw han niza kya buhang nya lala'.

S.FORM: mamelaw niza kya buhang i tiza i labu i lala' balautaw balautaw han niza kya buhang nya lala'.
S.PHON: mamə[r|ɾ]aw niza kja buħaŋ i tiza i [r|ɾ]abu i [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]a[ʔ|ʡ] ba[r|ɾ]autaw ba[r|ɾ]autaw ħan niza kja buħaŋ nja [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]a[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 他對著地上的洞喊:＂青蛙啊!青蛙啊!＂
He yelled to the hole on the ground, 'Frog! Frog!'

S.FORM: ya wacu sa waw waw waw mamelaw niza matating macacuy kya tatekuh.

S.TRANSL: 狗吠及看到虎頭蜂窩垂掛著.
The dog barked and saw the beehives hang.

S.FORM: kya izaw ku mityungay i takuan sa huyahuyen nya wacu kya kilang.
S.PHON: kja izaw ku mitjuŋaj i takuan sa ħujaħujən nja waʦu kja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ

S.TRANSL: (有人在輕拍) 那隻狗搖樹.
(Someone was patting.) That dog shook that tree.

S.FORM: mihuyahuy kya ma mahica mahica sa kya tatekuh.
S.PHON: miħujaħuj kja ma maħiʦa maħiʦa sa kja tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 虎頭蜂怎麼了?
How was that hornet?

S.FORM: tahkal mubahel kya tatekuh.

S.FORM: tahkal mubahel kya tatekuh.
S.PHON: taħka[r|ɾ] mubaħə[r|ɾ] kja tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 虎頭蜂飛出來.
The hornet flew out.

S.PHON: ja wawa nja niawawan kja ba[r|ɾ]aut i tiza i [r|ɾ]abu nu buħaŋ sa
S.TRANSL: 那小孩對著洞裡面呼喊著青蛙.
To the hole, that child yelled at the Frog.

S.FORM: matengil nya balaut ku ngiha' nya wawa tahkal kya balaut.
S.PHON: matəŋi[r|ɾ] nja ba[r|ɾ]aut ku ŋiħa[ʔ|ʡ] nja wawa taħka[r|ɾ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: matengil nya balaut ku ngiha' nya wawa tahkal kya balaut.

S.TRANSL: 那青蛙聽到聲音就出來.
That frog heard sound and came out.

S.FORM: ini kaku sa kya balaut.
S.PHON: ini kaku sa kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 青蛙說:＂我在這.＂
That frog said, "I am here."

FORM.notes: source note: SAW 中文意思近似於 ‘呢’ | source note: kya hian是kya hiya-en 那個 的縮寫

S.FORM: melaw han kya tatekuh kya kya hiyan ku luma' aku saw mahetik nanihuyahuyan nya wacu kya tatekuh mahetik.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan kja tatəkuħ kja kja ħijan ku [r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] aku saw maħətik naniħujaħujan nja waʦu kja tatəkuħ maħətik
S.FORM: melaw han kya tatekuh kya kya hiyan ku luma' aku saw mahetik nanihuyahuyan nya wacu kya tatekuh mahetik.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan kja tatəkuħ kja kja ħijan ku [r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] aku saw maħətik naniħujaħujan nja waʦu kja tatəkuħ maħətik
S.TRANSL: (為何把我家弄成這樣呢?) 虎頭蜂從狗搖的地方掉下來.
(Why did you do to my house?) The hornet fell off the place where the dog shook.

S.FORM: u canan ku mahiniay sa kya tatekuh maidih a mukalat tya wacuan.

S.FORM: u canan ku mahiniay sa kya tatekuh maidih a mukalat tya wacuan.
S.PHON: u ʦanan ku maħiniaj sa kja tatəkuħ maidiħ a muka[r|ɾ]at tja waʦuan
S.TRANSL: 虎頭蜂說:＂為何會這樣?＂ 而且想咬那隻狗.
The hornet said, "Why is it in this way?" and wanted to bite that dog.

S.TRANSL: 那小孩爬那個樹.
That child climbed that tree.

He saw a big tree with a big hole.

S.FORM: tayza ciniza a mimelaw u canan kina hiya sa.
S.PHON: tajza ʦiniza a mimə[r|ɾ]aw u ʦanan kina ħija sa
S.TRANSL: 他去看是什麼.
He went to see what it is.

S.FORM: susu' han nya wawa kya buhang nya kilang sa.
S.PHON: susu[ʔ|ʡ] ħan nja wawa kja buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ sa
S.FORM: susu' han nya wawa kya buhang nya kilang sa.
S.PHON: susu[ʔ|ʡ] ħan nja wawa kja buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ sa
S.TRANSL: 那小孩把手伸進樹洞裡.
